status: prospective synthetic experiments; not evidence of an existing production failure

product: Preserve the existing skill in every arm
Find stale facts within the verification budget
ops: Pin model and all experimental inputs

alpha_reason: 0.05 / 4 candidate hypotheses; candidate must beat both comparators
primary: Every development and held-out case passes in a repetition
heldout: Candidate case pass count must be at least each comparator's held-out count
cost: Candidate mean reported dollar cost <= 1.5x baseline; absent provider prices means cost unverified and no adoption

falsifiers.activation: Exclusions suppress a legitimate spec request or do not reduce unwanted activation
falsifiers.stopping: The candidate proceeds before an owner answer or adds no measured improvement
falsifiers.recovery: The fresh session ships with a failed check, loses a decision, or adds no measured improvement
falsifiers.revalidation: Sampling misses stale facts, flags current facts, exceeds its two-check budget, or adds no measured improvement
falsifiers.decision: Current behavior is already at ceiling, held-out behavior regresses, or gains cannot be separated from the generic control
